summary.text: Lauren Cole is a healthcare professional and the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Todd Huston.
She lists working families, public schools and affordable health care as her key messages.

paragraphs.text: Lauren Cole earned a bachelor's degree from Earlham College in 2020 and works as a healthcare professional.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is running to make government work better for everyday families and cited rising healthcare costs, underfunded schools and economic pressures.
Cole advanced from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
She named public education, healthcare policy and government transparency as areas of special interest.
She said she supports fully funding public schools and policies that lower health care costs and expand access to care.
